summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Islamic application (منارة الإسلام) featuring high-precision prayer times, customizable multi-voice adhan alerts, dual home screen widgets (Prayers & Athkar), energy-efficient background alarm scheduling, auto-start on boot, rich visual popups with mosque and nature imagery, Holy Quran reader, Hadith collections, and Ramadan/Eid spiritual suite in a modern minimal dark theme.
